Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Calicut is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc degree in Chemistry with a minimum of 60% marks or an equivalent grade, and they must be qualified in NET or GATE.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month, along with 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an offline interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Calicut located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Calicut is located in Calicut, Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. Will there be an interview for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Yes, the selection process includes an offline interview, with a tentative date scheduled for 24th September 2026.
